name: @muthuishere/vsync-s3-client
description: Read-side runtime library for the vsync ecosystem. Reads VSYNC_CONFIG + VSYNC_PASSPHRASE, fetches the manifest+bundle from S3, decrypts in-memory, exposes a get/has/source accessor with a deterministic fallback chain.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
